data.narrative:
Improbable Defence is a Growth-stage defence and security company that has raised $703M to date. The valuation exercise draws from a sector universe of 22 same-sector peers—comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems—though narrow peer comparability constraints limit the methods available.

Stage-Progression analysis, the sole applicable triangulation method, uses the $703M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, yielding $844M. This method reflects the company's capital intensity and progression trajectory within its stage cohort. Peer-Median analysis is not applicable; while 22 Defence & Security peers exist, insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting valuation-tier similarity criteria preclude reliable median benchmarking without introducing sector-wide noise.

The triangulated valuation range is $717M (low) to $970M (median to high), anchored at $844M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and absence of corroborating multiples data. Key uncertainties include the representative quality of the stage-progression multiplier for this subsector, limited visibility into peer revenue/EBITDA multiples, and the company's specific competitive positioning relative to the named private peer set. Any refinement would require materiality-weighted revenue or profitability comparables from the identified peer universe.
